claims: The MSC World Europa is a 215,863-GT cruise ship.
The MSC World Europa is LNG-powered.
The MSC World Europa was launched in 2022.
The MSC World Europa is MSC Cruises’ largest vessel.
The MSC World Europa carries up to 6,782 passengers.
The MSC World Europa has 20 decks.
The MSC World Europa features the 104m-long outdoor World Promenade.
The MSC World Europa features the 11-deck "Venom Drop" slide.
The MSC World Europa features 33 restaurants and bars.
The MSC World Europa features a "ship-within-a-ship" Yacht Club.
